title: Split cancellation above the residue homology bound
statement: Let S be affine and B a cochain complex of quasi-coherent finitely presented modules flat over id_S, supported in [0,b] for b∈ℕ. If its residue-field pullback homology vanishes in every natural degree q>d, then there exists D supported in [0,d], still termwise flat, quasi-coherent and finitely presented, with a chain homotopy equivalence D ≃ B. Pseudo-coherence and pullback homology comparisons are not conclusions of this cancellation lemma.

source.place: Tags 068V and 08EB; bounded finite-projective specialization with explicit split cancellation

proof.text: Induct on the natural upper support bound b, generalizing B. If b ≤ d, use B itself, monotonicity of IsStrictlyLE, and HomotopyEquiv.refl. In the successor case b+1 > d, pull B back to each residue field. The resulting complex is still strictly ≤ b+1. The vanishing hypothesis makes it exact at b+1, and its outgoing differential has zero target, so ShortComplex.Exact.epi_f makes the incoming differential epic. Apply the affine residue-epimorphism splitting criterion to B.d b (b+1).

Apply the one-step split-top cancellation statement to obtain B′ supported in [0,b], with the same termwise flatness, quasi-coherence and finite presentation and an equivalence e:B′≃B. For each residue-field pullback, mapHomotopyEquiv(e).toHomologyIso identifies its homology with that of B. IsZero.of_iso transfers the vanishing hypothesis to B′. Apply the induction hypothesis to B′, then compose its equivalence with e using HomotopyEquiv.trans. Natural induction terminates and covers d=0, zero top terms and the empty affine scheme.

proof_origin.place: Tags 068V, 068U, 00NX and 00MT; explicit finite-projective split cancellation argument, expanded by F2

lean.statement:
theorem affine_finitePresentation_flat_shortening_construction (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : IsAffine S) (B : CochainComplex S.Modules ℤ) (b d : ℕ)
    (hBge : B.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hBle : B.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hBflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (B.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 S))
    (hBqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (B.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hBfp : ∀ n : ℤ, (B.X n).IsFinitePresentation)
    (hvan : ∀ (s : S) (q : ℕ), d < q →
      IsZero ((((Modules.pullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
        B).homology q)) :
    ∃ D : CochainComplex S.Modules ℤ,
      D.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ D.IsStrictlyLE d ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (D.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 S)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (D.X n).IsQuasicoherent) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (D.X n).IsFinitePresentation) ∧
      Nonempty (HomotopyEquiv D B)
